title: Am I a Soldier of the Cross?
lyrics_original: Am I a soldier of the cross,
A follower of the Lamb,
And shall I fear to own His cause,
Or blush to speak His Name?
Must I be carried to the skies
On a flowery bed of ease,
While others fought to win the prize,
And sailed through bloody seas?
Are there no foes for me to face?
Must I not stem the flood?
Is this vile world a friend to grace,
To help me on to God?
Sure I must fight if I would reign;
Increase my courage, Lord.
I’ll bear the toil, endure the pain,
Supported by Thy Word.
Thy saints in all this glorious war
Shall conquer, though they die;
They see the triumph from afar,
By faith’s discerning eye.
When that illustrious day shall rise,
And all Thy armies shine
In robes of victory through the skies,
The glory shall be Thine.

bible_verses.english: You therefore must endure hardship, as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
Everyone therefore who publicly acknowledges me before men, I will also acknowledge before my Father who is in heaven.
He said to all, "If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross daily, and follow me.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for going before me and giving me the strength to follow You. Grant me the courage to speak Your name boldly and to live unashamed of the gospel. When trials come, help me to stand firm in Your truth rather than seeking easy paths. May my life honor Your sacrifice and point others to Your grace. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Following Jesus is a deeply rewarding journey, but it is not a call to comfortable ease. Isaac Watts’ classic hymn gently prompts us to examine our conviction: are we prepared to stand courageously for Christ, unashamed of His name? True faith invites us to step beyond comfort and take up our cross daily with grace and hope. Today, let His enduring strength empower you to walk faithfully through every trial.
